rationale: The task requests user-visible and functional changes in an existing AGDF repository, while the synthetic control state contains neither an approved durable UR nor a Brownfield decision. Under the fail-closed transition rules, the earliest permissible stage is UR.
decision_grounds: No approval or Brownfield decision is present.
Disclosure and TUI-warning changes affect user-visible behavior; version-drift handling may also affect runtime or owner
Later stages require an approved durable UR followed by Brownfield Review and a visible Mode/Slice Decision.
No eventual delivery path is evaluated at intake; compact_delivery prerequisites are absent.
